evidence.title: API handler: branch on empty Options + 400 on explicit --selected + persist accepted_as_proposed
evidence.description: scenarios/prompt-manager/api/heartbeat/handlers.go:2146-2159 implements the single-proposal validation branch. When effectiveStatus==accepted and the existing decision has no Options, an explicit non-empty Selected returns the exact mandated 400 error ('single-proposal decisions are accepted with no --selected; rerun without it'); otherwise acceptAsProposed is set to true. Lines 2269-2271 persist d.AcceptedAsProposed=true on the record. Multi-option behavior is unchanged.

evidence.title: Decision model: AcceptedAsProposed boolean field
evidence.description: scenarios/prompt-manager/api/store/models.go:495-498 adds AcceptedAsProposed bool with json tag accepted_as_proposed,omitempty plus a doc comment matching the plan's D2=A choice (explicit boolean, orthogonal to Selected/Freeform; no sentinel string). cli/teams/teams.go:205 mirrors the field on the CLI's DecisionEntry struct.

evidence.title: CLI decision-accept: pre-fetch, omit selected, single-proposal output
evidence.description: scenarios/prompt-manager/cli/teams/teams.go:2887-2987. Pre-fetches the decision via /teams/<id>/decisions?last=0, sets singleProposal := len(existing.Options)==0. If singleProposal AND --selected provided, returns the documented error. Otherwise multi-option still requires --selected. Request body omits Selected/Freeform when singleProposal (lines 2949-2960). Output at lines 2982-2983: 'Accepted decision <id> as proposed.' when AcceptedAsProposed||singleProposal.

evidence.title: decision-show legacy normalization helper (CLI)
evidence.description: scenarios/prompt-manager/cli/teams/teams.go:3273-3284 defines isAcceptedAsProposed(entry) which returns true when the new flag is set OR when len(Options)==0 AND Selected=='__other__' AND Freeform contains 'accept as proposed' (case-insensitive). Used at line 3263 inside the decision-show formatter. Covers the historical __other__+freeform shape per the plan's Risks mitigation.

evidence.title: UI parity: accept button + display copy
evidence.description: scenarios/prompt-manager/ui/src/components/editor/teamTabs/DecisionLogView.tsx:82-91 defines isAcceptedAsProposed(entry) covering both the new flag and the legacy shape. handleUpdateStatus (lines ~500-512) sends status-only payload (no selected/freeform) for accept. The accept button at line ~919 invokes handleUpdateStatus(entry, 'accepted'). Display block at lines 910-914 renders 'Accepted as proposed' copy when isAcceptedAsProposed(entry) is true.
